_doc: Curated villain defeat-requirement markers (WP-292 / D-24076). apply-defeat-requirement-markers.mjs appends a [require-to-defeat:<kind>:<value>] marker to the single ability line carrying the inline [<kind>:<value>] token on each named card. `kind` is the marker token: `team` or `hc` (hc → engine 'hero-class'). Pins exact set/group/card so look-alikes (e.g. the cvwr Size-Changing 'Venom') are never touched. `fightDiscardCosts` (WP-817 / D-24750) lists villains whose printed 'To fight X, you must also discard a card that costs …' line is a fight discard cost: the overlay appends [discard-to-fight:cost:<c>[+<c>…]] (costs strictly ascending) to the single line beginning with 'To fight ', and the engine reads it into G.villainFightDiscardCosts. `variableAttack` (WP-841 / D-24774) lists villains whose printed '<Villain> gets +N[icon:attack] …' passive raises their Attack at fight time: the overlay appends [variable-attack:<source>:<attackPerUnit>[@<space>[+<space>…]]] (source `flat`, `per-other-hydra-villain` or `per-hq-hero-class`; `spaces` required for `flat`) to the single line containing both ' gets +' and '[icon:attack]', and the engine reads it into G.villainVariableAttack. `fightRestrictions` (WP-871 / D-24816) lists City Villains whose printed 'You can't fight X unless / if …' line is a state-only fight restriction: the overlay appends [fight-restriction:<kind>] (kind `requires-villain-defeated-this-turn`, `at-most-one-card-played` or `no-adjacent-villain`) to the single line beginning with 'You can't fight ', and the engine reads it into G.villainFightRestrictions. `attackPerCaptured` (WP-838 / D-24771) lists villains whose printed '<Villain> gets +N[icon:attack] for each <Hero|Bystander> he has' passive counts the cards it has captured: the overlay appends [attack-per-captured:<kind>:<attackPerCard>] (kind `hero` or `bystander`) to the single line containing '[icon:attack] for each ', and the engine reads it into G.villainAttackPerCaptured, which replaces the default captured-Hero cost sum.
